kind: prospective REST acceptance controls, not a new blind chemistry batch

cases.script:
add v1 water 100mL @ 25C
add v1 CuSO4 0.001mol
inspect v1
add v1 Zn 0.001mol
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1
cases.expectation: Direct-contact copper deposition and aqueous zinc remain about1mmol each after the10s wait. SolidCuSO4 is absent before the wait and must not produce a gravity_settled separation. The original bogus event remains in the earlier replay.

cases.script:
add v1 water 100mL @ 25C
add v1 NaCl 0.001mol
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1
cases.expectation: DiluteNaCl dissolves completely. The subsequent wait must not settle absentNaClsolid; dissolvedNa/Cl remain eachabout1mmol.

cases.script:
add v1 water 100mL @ 25C
add v1 AgCl 0.007mol
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1
cases.expectation: SubstantialAgClsolid remains (above6mmol) before and after waiting. A positive gravity_settled separation for actually presentAgCl must still occur. Grain size is an explicit model assumption, not a measured settling calibration.

cases.script:
add v1 water 100mL @ 25C
add v1 H2SO4 0.001mol
inspect v1
electrolyse v1 0.1A 100s
inspect v1
wait 10s
inspect v1
cases.expectation: The supporting-acid10C electrolysis still reports positive exportedH2/O2in2:1molar ratio, approximate amounts5.18e-5/2.59e-5mol; waterconsumption matchesH2 and1mmolsulfate remains.

execution_prerequisites: Successful hosted exact-source AL2023 native build and actual microVM isolation/smoke checks.
Downloaded artifact/native/library hashes checked; actual healthengine source/binary/producerlock must match the artifact manifest before anyscript POST.
Freeze a separate observed engine/artifact binding before execution; no production deployment or branchintegration.
numerical_assessment_scope: For retained1mmolmetal/salt principals use1e-9mol absolute comparison, report raw values. This is a new saved-output assessment bound and does not change product conservation tolerances. Compare2:1gas ratio within1e-10relative and waterconsumption within1e-12mol.
limits: These controls assess the declared bug and positive particle behavior, not empirical grain/settling kinetics, yield, current efficiency or heat calibration.
Passing REST does not replace all product native/core/browser/full-fleet acceptance.
Validation-only combined branch must never merge into main.
